claim: The current registered public corpus cannot rank task features by their predictive strength for token usage.
evidence_class: registry coverage audit and official measurement-surface comparison
quality_class: A for interface semantics; E for an empirical predictor ranking because no admissible run population exists
limitations: No accepted A-C numerical-prior runs
No compatible task-feature, usage, model, framework and outcome join
Registry incompleteness is not proof that no private evidence exists
permitted_wording: The 2A corpus preregisters candidate features but cannot rank their token-prediction strength.

claim: Task size, tool profile, session continuation, reasoning effort, agent count, ambiguity and horizon are candidate predictors that should be measured prospectively, not established predictors from this corpus.
quality_class: D for routing effect; supported only as measurement design
limitations: No effect sizes
No ranking
Possible confounding by task difficulty, framework and budget
permitted_wording: These features are plausible preregistered covariates for 2B.

claim: The current corpus cannot identify the strongest predictors of completed failure, retry, budget censoring or escalation.
limitations: Incomplete failed-run populations
Retry and escalation semantics are framework-defined
Infrastructure, verifier and budget failures are often conflated or missing
permitted_wording: Outcome-capable benchmarks exist, but comparable usage-linked failure chains do not.

claim: A lower-priced first attempt is economically worse only when its added failed-attempt, retry, escalation, verification, tool and human-review costs exceed the initial saving.
quality_class: A for price/usage field semantics; no empirical threshold
limitations: No complete route-chain sample
Failure penalty and human-time valuation are policy inputs
Current pricing is not a historical price ledger
permitted_wording: This is the accepted-cost accounting condition, not an estimated break-even point.

claim: The 2A corpus cannot estimate a break-even failure or escalation probability for any cheaper-versus-stronger model pair.
limitations: Organization usage and cost are bucketed and not task-linked
Public trajectories omit complete attempts and dated cost components
permitted_wording: No model-pair economic crossover is estimated in 2A.

claim: No evidence-based task region in which Spark is genuinely more efficient can be derived from the registered corpus.
limitations: No controlled Spark run population
No alias-to-immutable-model mapping established in this corpus
Efficiency requires accepted outcome, cost scope and matched conditions
permitted_wording: Spark efficiency remains unmeasured; do not infer it from the label or price alone.

claim: No task stratum in which Luna minimizes accepted-task cost is established by 2A.
limitations: No Luna attempt chains
No complete failures/retries/escalations
No alias resolution or dated cost population
permitted_wording: Luna cost-minimizing conditions require local matched route-chain evidence.

claim: No economic crossover between Terra and Luna is established by 2A.
limitations: No same-task same-framework comparison
No immutable identity mapping
Reasoning effort, tool set, budget and verifier are uncontrolled
permitted_wording: Do not infer Terra-over-Luna economics from aliases, version order or capability reputation.

claim: The 2A corpus cannot identify ambiguity or risk thresholds that justify routing directly to Sol.
evidence_class: policy boundary and missing calibration evidence
limitations: No calibrated Sol outcome population
Alias unresolved
Risk tolerance and human-approval boundaries are policy choices
permitted_wording: Safety and approval gates precede cost, but a Sol trigger is not empirically calibrated in 2A.

claim: Official agent and Codex surfaces expose tool events and aggregate usage, but no inspected field directly partitions subsequent input tokens attributable to tool output.
quality_class: A for field availability; E for magnitude
limitations: Tool-call count is not payload size
Tools can affect later requests rather than the call where they run
Trace payloads can be sensitive
permitted_wording: Tool-output amplification is measurable only with local component attribution; its share is unknown in 2A.

claim: Cumulative run or session usage cannot be interpreted as current context occupancy or as tokens re-sent from history.
limitations: App-server fields are version-gated
Current context occupancy is not exposed by codex exec usage
History/tool/compaction components remain unpartitioned
permitted_wording: Report cumulative usage, last-turn usage and measured context occupancy as separate fields.

claim: Cached input remains logical input processed and context-bearing even when it is billed at a cache-specific rate.
limitations: Rates and cache-write behavior vary by model and date
Subscription quota cannot be inferred from API prices
Cached tokens still count toward token rate limits
permitted_wording: Caching may reduce API-billed input cost without reducing logical input tokens; preserve total and cached input separately.

claim: Primary multi-agent examples show that inter-agent coordination can contribute large input volumes in bespoke systems.
limitations: Small or bespoke samples
Agent count, task, model and scaffold change together
Incomplete request and failure accounting
permitted_wording: Multi-agent coordination can amplify tokens; these examples do not quantify a general effect.

claim: No causal agent-count effect on total tokens or pass rate can be estimated from the inspected sources.
quality_class: E for a causal response curve
limitations: No matched or randomized agent-count experiment
No common task/model/budget accounting
Parallel elapsed time differs from summed resource use
permitted_wording: Agent-count effects require matched or randomized runs with per-agent attribution.

claim: Most inspected historical agent and benchmark artifacts are unusable for numerical routing priors in their current form because exact provider token accounting, complete outcomes, stable model identity, or publication rights are missing.
evidence_class: primary-source dataset and license coverage audit
quality_class: A/B for observed field and rights gaps; no numerical run class assigned
limitations: Some sources may contain uninspected private or heterogeneous usage metadata
Unusable for numerical priors does not mean unusable for taxonomy or verifier design
Dataset status can change with new releases
permitted_wording: The currently inspected forms must not influence numerical token routing priors; retain only explicitly supported qualitative or structural uses.

claim: No single official surface supplies a complete accepted-task record linking task, route decision, attempts, requests, tools, usage, compactions, verifier outcome, price basis and human review.
limitations: Surface capabilities are version-dependent
Organization usage/cost is aggregated
Application-defined outcome and route semantics are required
permitted_wording: SmartRouter 2B must create privacy-minimized join keys and collect the missing operational fields locally.

claim: Raw prompts, hidden reasoning, private transcripts and credentials are not required to estimate token economics and should not be published.
quality_class: A for official trace-content warning; B/D across third-party artifacts
limitations: Allowlisted derived metadata still needs secret and personal-data review
Some research questions may require local component counts, not raw text
permitted_wording: Collect counts, hashes, categorical features, outcomes and bounded payload sizes instead of raw sensitive content.

claim: The numerical-prior gate must remain closed until A-C quality runs have compatible accounting, objective outcomes, complete attempt chains, license clarity and grouped evaluation.
quality_class: A/B for observed interface and coverage facts; no admissible numerical prior
limitations: A future audited source or local 2B corpus can change the gate
Quality class alone is insufficient without compatibility and leakage controls
permitted_wording: 2A provides a measurement plan, not fitted empirical routing rules.
